wire.headline: Utility giant reports mixed financial results and announces significant workforce reductions
sentences: The company reported revenue of 4.26bn GBP for the quarter to 30 September, marking a 7% year-on-year increase.
Pre-tax profit decreased by 12% to reach 310m GBP.
The organization is cutting 850 jobs, which represents about 6% of its total workforce.
Two gas plants are scheduled to close by March 2027, with locations in Wales and Kent.
CEO Marian Holt stated that cost pressure has been sharper than expected.
Ofgem has opened an investigation into the company's billing system.
The dividend was held at 12.4p a share.
Shares fell by 4.2% during morning trading.

PD.headline: Kestrel Securities Faces Workforce Reductions Amid Cost Pressures

sentences.text: For the quarter to 30 September, the company reported revenue of 4.26bn GBP, marking a 7% year-on-year increase.
The company has announced plans for 850 job cuts, which represents about 6% of its workforce.
CEO Marian Holt stated that the cost pressure is sharper than expected.
A Kestrel Securities analyst indicated that the job cuts will save 90m GBP a year.
Unite plans to ballot its members on taking industrial action.
The MP for Deeside is requesting an urgent meeting with the company.

ND.headline: Company announces job cuts and profit decline amid regulatory scrutiny

sentences.text: The pre-tax profit fell by 12% to reach 310m GBP.
The organization plans to cut 850 jobs, which represents about 6% of the workforce.
A Kestrel Securities analyst stated that the job cuts will save 90m GBP a year.
The union Unite intends to ballot its members on industrial action.
The Kent plant employs 410 staff, leaving the local supply chain exposed.
The MP for Deeside has requested an urgent meeting with the company.
Since 2024, 1,200 staff have left under a voluntary scheme.
Ofgem is scheduled to report preliminary findings by the end of 2026.
The shares closed at 268p, marking a drop of 11p.
A customer group recorded 3,400 billing complaints in a six-month period.
Negotiations with the unions are set to begin on 4 November.
In 2023, Ofgem fined the company 1.8m GBP regarding billing issues.
The company stated that there will be no compulsory redundancies before January 2027.

This report was published by the Western Mail.
